_note: Written by npm run precompute; do not edit. Species routes: models, not tracked movements. Positions in decimetres from the kit centre (east, north, up). habitats: the arrows on the map edge (dir: outward) and the green areas inside the map that are sources. anchors: every place routes run between (habitats and the largest existing green areas). routes: each computed once on the Around 2100 city and drawn with the same line (xyz_dm, already offset to its lane and lifted over roofs) in every layout from the one it appears in. end_type: how it ends where it works (stay: the species circle at a potential home; loop: back with an arrowhead near its start; cross: an arrowhead leaving the map). layouts.<key>: null before the route appears; cut: index into the line where it is broken there (a small cross), null when it works; home: the home at the end of a stay route has grown up; homes_dm: potential homes along the drawn part, x, y pairs. shared: runs [i0, i1, other route id, j0, j1] where points i0..i1 lie along points j0..j1 of an earlier route of the same species; drawn once, by that route, wherever it is drawn. Loop routes hold the way out only (the way back is the same). circles: one or two per route, idx: the line point the species circle is centred on; kind end (stay routes, shown where they work) or key (shown where the route is drawn past it). summary: per species and layout.
